Relative Interaction Index with a bootstrap interval

Source: R/index.R
pollin_rii.Rd

The Relative Interaction Index (Armas et al. 2004) is widely reported for pollinator dependence as a bare point estimate, despite being a ratio of two correlated sums whose sampling distribution is awkward. This function returns the index with a nonparametric bootstrap interval, the minimum upgrade over a point value. Prefer the model-based contribution (pollin_contribution()) as the primary estimate and keep this for comparability with the existing literature.

Usage

pollin_rii(
  open,
  cage,
  n_boot = 2000L,
  conf = 0.95,
  seed = NULL,
  response = NULL,
  unit = NULL
)

Arguments

open

Numeric vector of the open-arm (pollinator-accessible) values, or a pollin_design() with an "excluded" and an "open" arm.

cage

Numeric vector of the exclusion-arm values. Leave it empty when open is a design.

n_boot

Number of bootstrap resamples.

conf

Confidence level.

seed

Optional integer seed for reproducibility.

response

With a design, the response column to use. It may be left NULL when the data declare one response.

unit

With a design, the unit column the arm means are taken over, one of the design's unit nesting. NULL (the default) uses the outermost unit; an inner unit is taken within its outer units.

Value

An object of class pollin_rii.

Details

The arm values are given either as two vectors or as a pollin_design(). From a design, the values are unit-level arm means: the mean response of each unit in the open arm and in the excluded arm, for the units carrying both arms, in sorted unit order. The bootstrap then runs on those means as it does on two vectors.

Examples

set.seed(1)
pollin_rii(rpois(50, 8), rpois(50, 6), n_boot = 500, seed = 1)
#> RII = 0.160  [95% boot CI: 0.105, 0.219]  (n_open=50, n_cage=50)

# From a design: one mean per site and arm
df <- data.frame(
  pods = rpois(48, 30),
  trt = rep(c("Cage", "Open"), 24),
  Site = rep(letters[1:4], each = 12)
)
pd <- pollin_data(df, "pods", "trt", unit = "Site")
ds <- pollin_design(pd, c(excluded = "Cage", open = "Open"), "multi_site")
pollin_rii(ds, n_boot = 200, seed = 1)
#> RII = -0.023  [95% boot CI: -0.081, 0.021]  (n_open=4, n_cage=4)
